# Contributing to ENKI

Thank you for contributing!

Please follow these guidelines to keep the project organized.

---

## Workflow

1. Create or pick an assigned GitHub Issue.
2. Create a new branch from `main`.
3. Implement your changes.
4. Commit using descriptive commit messages.
5. Push your branch.
6. Open a Pull Request.
7. Wait for review before merging.

---

## Branch Naming

Use one of the following prefixes:

```text
feature/<name>

bugfix/<name>

docs/<name>

test/<name>

refactor/<name>
```

Example:

```text
feature/gesture-recognition
```

---

## Commit Messages

Follow Conventional Commits.

Examples:

```text
feat: add gesture recognizer

fix: resolve camera initialization bug

docs: update installation guide

refactor: simplify tracking pipeline
```

---

## Pull Requests

Every Pull Request should:

- Reference the related Issue.
- Describe the changes made.
- Explain how the feature was tested.
- Keep the scope focused on one task.

---

## Code Style

- Write readable code.
- Add comments only when necessary.
- Remove unused code before submitting.
- Keep functions and modules modular.

---

## Documentation

If your change affects project usage or architecture,
please update the relevant documentation.

---

## Communication

If you're blocked or unable to complete your assigned task,
inform the team as early as possible.
